3	//! promoted run, and rolls every leaf's tamper-evident gate verdict up to the top.

79	/// Guard a requested campaign against the depth cap and ancestor cycles.
80	///
81	/// `current_depth` is the depth of the process requesting the campaign (0 for a
82	/// top-level invocation, 1 for a sub-orchestrator). The sub-orchestrators a
83	/// campaign launches sit at `current_depth + 1`; if that would reach
84	/// [`CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH`] the campaign is refused. A requested sub-goal whose
85	/// `task_key` or resolved scope matches an ancestor's is refused as a cycle.
86	pub fn guard(
87	    current_depth: u32,
88	    ancestor_task_keys: &[String],
89	    ancestor_scopes: &[String],
90	    requested_sub_task_keys: &[String],
91	    requested_sub_scopes: &[String],
92	) -> Result<()> {
93	    if current_depth + 1 >= CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
94	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
95	            "campaign refused: depth cap {CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH} reached\n\
96	             try: run `orchestrate full-plan` (not campaign) inside a sub-orchestrator"
97	        )));
98	    }
99	    for key in requested_sub_task_keys {
100	        if ancestor_task_keys.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == key) {
101	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
102	                "campaign refused: sub-goal task_key '{key}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
103	                 try: reword the sub-goal so its task differs from an ancestor"
104	            )));
105	        }
106	    }
107	    for scope in requested_sub_scopes {
108	        if ancestor_scopes.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == scope) {
109	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
110	                "campaign refused: sub-goal scope '{scope}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
111	                 try: launch the campaign from a different checkout"
112	            )));
113	        }
114	    }
115	    Ok(())
116	}

229	/// Turn planner output (N sub-goal strings) into validated [`SubGoal`]s. Refuses a
230	/// count that does not match the request, an empty sub-goal, or a duplicate
231	/// (whitespace- and case-normalized).
232	pub fn build_sub_goals(goals: Vec<String>, requested_n: usize) -> Result<Vec<SubGoal>> {
233	    if goals.len() != requested_n {
234	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
235	            "campaign planner returned {} sub-goals; expected exactly {requested_n}",
236	            goals.len()
237	        )));
238	    }
239	    validate_task_count(goals.len())?;
240	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
241	    let mut subs = Vec::with_capacity(goals.len());
242	    for (index, goal) in goals.into_iter().enumerate() {
243	        let trimmed = goal.trim();
244	        if trimmed.is_empty() {
245	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
246	                "campaign sub-goal must not be empty".to_string(),
247	            ));
248	        }
249	        let normalized = trimmed
250	            .split_whitespace()
251	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
252	            .join(" ")
253	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
254	        if !seen.insert(normalized) {
255	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
256	                "duplicate campaign sub-goal: {trimmed}"
257	            )));
258	        }
259	        subs.push(SubGoal {
260	            sub_id: format!("sub-{index}"),
261	            goal: trimmed.to_string(),
262	            task_key: crate::paths::task_key(trimmed),
263	            sub_plan_id: None,
264	            result_run_id: None,
265	            scope: None,
266	            status: SubGoalStatus::Pending,
267	        });
268	    }
269	    Ok(subs)
270	}

333	/// Build a [`Lineage`] from the campaign env-var values (any may be absent). This
334	/// is the pure core of reading lineage out of the process environment; absent
335	/// depth means depth 0 (a top-level invocation).
336	pub fn parse_lineage(
337	    depth: Option<&str>,
338	    campaign_root_id: Option<&str>,
339	    ancestor_task_keys: Option<&str>,
340	    ancestor_scopes: Option<&str>,
341	) -> Lineage {
342	    let split = |value: Option<&str>| -> Vec<String> {
343	        value
344	            .map(|raw| {
345	                raw.split(',')
346	                    .map(str::trim)
347	                    .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
348	                    .map(ToString::to_string)
349	                    .collect()
350	            })
351	            .unwrap_or_default()
352	    };
353	    Lineage {
354	        schema_version: 1,
355	        depth: depth.and_then(|raw| raw.trim().parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
356	        campaign_root_id: campaign_root_id
357	            .map(str::trim)
358	            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
359	            .map(ToString::to_string),
360	        ancestor_task_keys: split(ancestor_task_keys),
361	        ancestor_scopes: split(ancestor_scopes),
362	    }
363	}

423	/// Split a campaign's tree-wide spend ceiling evenly across N sub-orchestrators.
424	/// Computed in whole cents so the shares sum back to the ceiling exactly; any
425	/// leftover cent goes to the earliest subs (remainder-to-first).
426	pub fn allocate_budget(tree_budget: f64, n: usize) -> Vec<f64> {
427	    if n == 0 {
428	        return Vec::new();
429	    }
430	    let total_cents = (tree_budget * 100.0).round() as i64;
431	    let base = total_cents / n as i64;
432	    let remainder = total_cents - base * n as i64;
433	    (0..n)
434	        .map(|index| {
435	            let cents = if (index as i64) < remainder {
436	                base + 1
437	            } else {
438	                base
439	            };
440	            cents as f64 / 100.0
441	        })
442	        .collect()
443	}

445	/// Whether the aggregate spend across already-launched leaf runs has reached the
446	/// campaign's tree ceiling. An absent ceiling is never exhausted.
447	pub fn tree_budget_exhausted(tree_budget: Option<f64>, spent_usd: f64) -> bool {
448	    tree_budget.is_some_and(|cap| spent_usd >= cap)
449	}
450	
451	/// The warning to surface when a campaign runs with no tree budget: each
452	/// sub-orchestrator falls back to the default per-run cap, so the whole tree is
453	/// unbounded. Returns `None` when a ceiling is set.
454	pub fn unbounded_budget_warning(tree_budget: Option<f64>) -> Option<String> {
455	    if tree_budget.is_none() {
456	        Some(
457	            "campaign tree budget is unbounded: each sub-orchestrator inherits the default \
458	             per-run cap. pass --max-spend to bound the whole tree"
459	                .to_string(),
460	        )
461	    } else {
462	        None
463	    }
464	}
465	
466	const ROLLUP_FILE: &str = "campaign-rollup.json";
467	
468	/// The aggregate trust verdict of a campaign, worst-of across every leaf run.
469	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
470	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
471	pub enum RollupVerdict {
472	    Clean,
473	    Caveat,
474	    Refused,
475	}
476	
477	/// One leaf run's contribution to the roll-up.
478	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
479	pub struct LeafVerdict {
480	    pub sub_id: String,
481	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
482	    pub result_run_id: Option<String>,
483	    /// "signed" | "refused" | "missing" — whether the leaf produced a valid gate.
484	    pub gate: String,
485	    pub tamper_verdict: AcceptanceTamperVerdict,
486	    #[serde(default)]
487	    pub caveats: Vec<String>,
488	}
489	
490	impl LeafVerdict {
491	    /// The leaf's effective trust verdict: a leaf with no valid signed gate counts
492	    /// as refused regardless of its tamper verdict.
493	    pub fn effective(&self) -> RollupVerdict {
494	        if self.gate != "signed" {
495	            return RollupVerdict::Refused;
496	        }
497	        match self.tamper_verdict {
498	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Clean => RollupVerdict::Clean,
499	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Caveat => RollupVerdict::Caveat,
500	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse => RollupVerdict::Refused,
501	        }
502	    }
503	}
504	
505	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
506	pub struct CampaignRollup {
507	    pub schema_version: u32,
508	    pub campaign_id: String,
509	    pub evaluated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
510	    pub leaves: Vec<LeafVerdict>,
511	    pub rollup_verdict: RollupVerdict,
512	    pub refused_subs: Vec<String>,
513	    pub caveat_subs: Vec<String>,
514	}
515	
516	/// Worst-of across leaf verdicts: any refused wins, else any caveat, else clean.
517	/// An empty leaf set is refused (a campaign with nothing merged is not clean).
518	pub fn worst_of(verdicts: &[RollupVerdict]) -> RollupVerdict {
519	    if verdicts.is_empty() {
520	        return RollupVerdict::Refused;
521	    }
522	    if verdicts.contains(&RollupVerdict::Refused) {
523	        RollupVerdict::Refused
524	    } else if verdicts.contains(&RollupVerdict::Caveat) {
525	        RollupVerdict::Caveat
526	    } else {
527	        RollupVerdict::Clean
528	    }
529	}
530	
531	/// A campaign may reach clean completion only if no leaf was refused. This is the
532	/// no-laundering invariant: nesting cannot turn a refused leaf into a clean result.
533	pub fn rollup_permits_completion(verdict: RollupVerdict) -> bool {
534	    verdict != RollupVerdict::Refused
535	}
536	
537	/// Build the roll-up from a campaign and a per-leaf lookup that yields each result
538	/// run's gate state, tamper verdict, and caveats. A sub with no merged result run
539	/// is recorded as a missing (refused) leaf.
540	pub fn build_rollup<F>(campaign: &Campaign, mut leaf_lookup: F) -> CampaignRollup
541	where
542	    F: FnMut(&str) -> (String, AcceptanceTamperVerdict, Vec<String>),
543	{
544	    let mut leaves = Vec::new();
545	    for sub in &campaign.sub_goals {
546	        let leaf = match sub.result_run_id.as_deref() {
547	            Some(run_id) => {
548	                let (gate, tamper_verdict, caveats) = leaf_lookup(run_id);
549	                LeafVerdict {
550	                    sub_id: sub.sub_id.clone(),
551	                    result_run_id: Some(run_id.to_string()),
552	                    gate,
553	                    tamper_verdict,
554	                    caveats,
555	                }
556	            }
557	            None => LeafVerdict {
558	                sub_id: sub.sub_id.clone(),
559	                result_run_id: None,
560	                gate: "missing".to_string(),
561	                tamper_verdict: AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse,
562	                caveats: Vec::new(),
563	            },
564	        };
565	        leaves.push(leaf);
566	    }
567	    let effective: Vec<RollupVerdict> = leaves.iter().map(LeafVerdict::effective).collect();
568	    let refused_subs = leaves
569	        .iter()
570	        .filter(|leaf| leaf.effective() == RollupVerdict::Refused)
571	        .map(|leaf| leaf.sub_id.clone())
572	        .collect();
573	    let caveat_subs = leaves
574	        .iter()
575	        .filter(|leaf| leaf.effective() == RollupVerdict::Caveat)
576	        .map(|leaf| leaf.sub_id.clone())
577	        .collect();
578	    CampaignRollup {
579	        schema_version: 1,
580	        campaign_id: campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
581	        evaluated_at: Utc::now(),
582	        leaves,
583	        rollup_verdict: worst_of(&effective),
584	        refused_subs,
585	        caveat_subs,
586	    }
587	}
588	
589	/// A campaign reaches clean completion only when every sub merged *and* the
590	/// roll-up permits completion (no refused leaf). This is where the no-laundering
591	/// invariant meets the all-subs-done requirement.
592	pub fn campaign_can_complete(campaign: &Campaign, rollup: &CampaignRollup) -> bool {
593	    campaign
594	        .sub_goals
595	        .iter()
596	        .all(|sub| sub.status == SubGoalStatus::Merged)
597	        && rollup_permits_completion(rollup.rollup_verdict)
598	}
599	
600	pub fn rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
601	    plan_dir.join(ROLLUP_FILE)
602	}
603	
604	/// Where a campaign result run carries its bound roll-up (hashed into the run's
605	/// acceptance-marker signature by the gate).
606	pub fn rollup_path_at_run_root(run_root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
607	    run_root.join(ROLLUP_FILE)
608	}
609	
610	pub fn write_campaign_rollup(plan_dir: &Path, rollup: &CampaignRollup) -> Result<()> {
611	    crate::state::atomic_write_json(&rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir), rollup)
612	}
613	
614	pub fn read_campaign_rollup(plan_dir: &Path) -> Result<CampaignRollup> {
615	    let path = rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir);
616	    let bytes = std::fs::read(&path).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
617	        path: path.clone(),
618	        source,
619	    })?;
620	    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source })
621	}

125	pub fn validate_acceptance_marker(state: &PipelineState) -> Result<AcceptanceMarker> {
126	    // AS-BUILT §8/§17: completion is accepted only from an external marker
127	    // written by a binary runner and bound to this run_id.
128	    let path = marker_path(state);
129	    let raw = std::fs::read(&path).with_path(&path)?;
130	    let marker: AcceptanceMarker = serde_json::from_slice(&raw).with_json_path(&path)?;
131	    if marker.schema_version != 1 {
132	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
133	            "unsupported acceptance marker schema {}",
134	            marker.schema_version
135	        )));
136	    }
137	    if marker.run_id != state.run_id {
138	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
139	            "acceptance marker run_id {} does not match {}",
140	            marker.run_id, state.run_id
141	        )));
142	    }
143	    if marker.status != "pass" || marker.produced_by != "dr-gate" {
144	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
145	            "acceptance marker was not produced by dr-gate with pass status".to_string(),
146	        ));
147	    }
148	    let expected = marker_signature(&state.run_root, &marker)?;
149	    if marker.signature != expected {
150	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
151	            "acceptance marker signature is invalid; forged self-attestation refused".to_string(),
152	        ));
153	    }
154	    Ok(marker)
155	}

157	pub fn write_acceptance_marker(
158	    run_root: &Path,
159	    run_id: String,
160	    working_dir: PathBuf,
161	    check_count: usize,
162	) -> Result<AcceptanceMarker> {
163	    let checks = (0..check_count)
164	        .map(|idx| AcceptanceCheckResult {
165	            kind: "legacy".to_string(),
166	            passed: true,
167	            must_pass: true,
168	            detail: format!("legacy check {}", idx + 1),
169	            command: None,
170	            cwd: None,
171	            duration_ms: None,
172	            stdout: None,
173	            stderr: None,
174	        })
175	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
176	    write_acceptance_marker_with_results(run_root, run_id, working_dir, checks)
177	}

179	pub fn write_acceptance_marker_with_results(
180	    run_root: &Path,
181	    run_id: String,
182	    working_dir: PathBuf,
183	    checks: Vec<AcceptanceCheckResult>,
184	) -> Result<AcceptanceMarker> {
185	    let proofs = run_root.join("proofs");
186	    std::fs::create_dir_all(&proofs).with_path(&proofs)?;
187	    let mut marker = AcceptanceMarker {
188	        schema_version: 1,
189	        run_id,
190	        status: "pass".to_string(),
191	        produced_by: "dr-gate".to_string(),
192	        checked_at: Utc::now(),
193	        working_dir,
194	        signature: String::new(),
195	        check_count: checks.len(),
196	        checks,
197	    };
198	    marker.signature = marker_signature(run_root, &marker)?;
199	    std::fs::write(
200	        proofs.join(ACCEPTANCE_MARKER),
201	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&marker).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
202	            path: proofs.join(ACCEPTANCE_MARKER),
203	            source,
204	        })?,
205	    )
206	    .with_path(proofs.join(ACCEPTANCE_MARKER))?;
207	    Ok(marker)
208	}

210	pub fn run_acceptance_gate_and_write_marker(
211	    run_root: &Path,
212	    run_id: &str,
213	    working_dir: &Path,
214	) -> Result<AcceptanceMarker> {
215	    let results = evaluate_acceptance_checks_with_progress(run_root, working_dir)?;
216	    let checks = compiled_acceptance_checks(run_root, working_dir)?;
217	    let tamper = crate::tamper::evaluate(run_id, run_root, working_dir, &checks)?;
218	    crate::tamper::write_acceptance_tamper(run_root, &tamper)?;
219	    if tamper.verdict == AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse {
220	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
221	            "acceptance refused: {}",
222	            tamper.refusal_reasons.join("; ")
223	        )));
224	    }
225	    if let Some(failed) = results
226	        .iter()
227	        .find(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed)
228	    {
229	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
230	            "acceptance check failed: {}",
231	            failed.detail
232	        )));
233	    }
234	    write_acceptance_marker_with_results(
235	        run_root,
236	        run_id.to_string(),
237	        working_dir.to_path_buf(),
238	        results,
239	    )
240	}

284	pub fn compiled_acceptance_checks(
285	    run_root: &Path,
286	    working_dir: &Path,
287	) -> Result<Vec<AcceptanceCheck>> {
288	    let spec_path = acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(run_root);
289	    if spec_path.exists() {
290	        let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&spec_path).with_path(&spec_path)?;
291	        return parse_acceptance_checks(&raw);
292	    }
293	    if working_dir.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
294	        return Ok(vec![AcceptanceCheck::CargoTest {
295	            args: Vec::new(),
296	            must_pass: true,
297	        }]);
298	    }
299	    Ok(vec![AcceptanceCheck::FileExists {
300	        path: "{working_dir}".to_string(),
301	        must_pass: true,
302	    }])
303	}

309	fn evaluate_acceptance_checks_inner(
310	    run_root: &Path,
311	    working_dir: &Path,
312	    progress_path: Option<&Path>,
313	) -> Result<Vec<AcceptanceCheckResult>> {
314	    let spec_path = acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(run_root);
315	    if !spec_path.exists() {
316	        return evaluate_default_acceptance_with_progress(working_dir, progress_path);
317	    }
318	    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&spec_path).with_path(&spec_path)?;
319	    let checks = parse_acceptance_checks(&raw)?;
320	    let total = checks.len();
321	    emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, "started", 0, total, None)?;
322	    let mut results = Vec::new();
323	    for (idx, check) in checks.into_iter().enumerate() {
324	        let index = idx + 1;
325	        emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, "running", index, total, None)?;
326	        let result = evaluate_check(working_dir, check)?;
327	        let status = if result.passed { "passed" } else { "failed" };
328	        emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, status, index, total, Some(result.clone()))?;
329	        results.push(result);
330	    }
331	    let status = if results
332	        .iter()
333	        .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed)
334	    {
335	        "failed"
336	    } else {
337	        "passed"
338	    };
339	    emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, status, total, total, None)?;
340	    Ok(results)
341	}

343	fn evaluate_default_acceptance_with_progress(
344	    working_dir: &Path,
345	    progress_path: Option<&Path>,
346	) -> Result<Vec<AcceptanceCheckResult>> {
347	    emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, "started", 0, 1, None)?;
348	    emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, "running", 1, 1, None)?;
349	    let results = evaluate_default_acceptance(working_dir)?;
350	    if let Some(result) = results.first().cloned() {
351	        let status = if result.passed { "passed" } else { "failed" };
352	        emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, status, 1, 1, Some(result))?;
353	    }
354	    let status = if results
355	        .iter()
356	        .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed)
357	    {
358	        "failed"
359	    } else {
360	        "passed"
361	    };
362	    emit_acceptance_progress(progress_path, status, 1, 1, None)?;
363	    Ok(results)
364	}

366	fn emit_acceptance_progress(
367	    progress_path: Option<&Path>,
368	    status: &str,
369	    index: usize,
370	    total: usize,
371	    result: Option<AcceptanceCheckResult>,
372	) -> Result<()> {
373	    let Some(progress_path) = progress_path else {
374	        return Ok(());
375	    };
376	    append_json_line(

378	        &AcceptanceProgressEntry {
379	            checked_at: Utc::now(),
380	            status: status.to_string(),
381	            index,
382	            total,
383	            result,
384	        },
385	    )
386	}

388	fn evaluate_default_acceptance(working_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<AcceptanceCheckResult>> {
389	    if working_dir.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
390	        let started = Instant::now();
391	        let output = Command::new("cargo")
392	            .arg("test")
393	            .current_dir(working_dir)
394	            .output()
395	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
396	                path: working_dir.join("Cargo.toml"),
397	                source,
398	            })?;
399	        return Ok(vec![AcceptanceCheckResult {
400	            kind: "cargo_test".to_string(),
401	            passed: output.status.success(),
402	            must_pass: true,
403	            detail: format!("cargo test exited with {}", output.status),
404	            command: Some("cargo test".to_string()),
405	            cwd: Some(working_dir.to_path_buf()),
406	            duration_ms: Some(duration_ms(started)),
407	            stdout: clipped_stdout(&output),
408	            stderr: clipped_stderr(&output),
409	        }]);
410	    }
411	    if !working_dir.is_dir() {
412	        return Ok(vec![AcceptanceCheckResult {
413	            kind: "working_dir".to_string(),
414	            passed: false,
415	            must_pass: true,
416	            detail: format!("working directory missing: {}", working_dir.display()),
417	            command: None,
418	            cwd: Some(working_dir.to_path_buf()),
419	            duration_ms: None,
420	            stdout: None,
421	            stderr: None,
422	        }]);
423	    }
424	    Ok(vec![AcceptanceCheckResult {
425	        kind: "working_dir".to_string(),
426	        passed: true,
427	        must_pass: true,
428	        detail: "working directory exists".to_string(),
429	        command: None,
430	        cwd: Some(working_dir.to_path_buf()),
431	        duration_ms: None,
432	        stdout: None,
433	        stderr: None,
434	    }])
435	}

437	fn evaluate_check(working_dir: &Path, check: AcceptanceCheck) -> Result<AcceptanceCheckResult> {
438	    match check {
439	        AcceptanceCheck::CargoTest { args, must_pass } => {
440	            let started = Instant::now();
441	            let output = Command::new("cargo")
442	                .arg("test")
443	                .args(&args)
444	                .current_dir(working_dir)
445	                .output()
446	                .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
447	                    path: working_dir.join("Cargo.toml"),
448	                    source,
449	                })?;
450	            Ok(AcceptanceCheckResult {
451	                kind: "cargo_test".to_string(),
452	                passed: output.status.success(),
453	                must_pass,
454	                detail: format!("cargo test exited with {}", output.status),
455	                command: Some(format_command("cargo test", &args)),
456	                cwd: Some(working_dir.to_path_buf()),
457	                duration_ms: Some(duration_ms(started)),
458	                stdout: clipped_stdout(&output),
459	                stderr: clipped_stderr(&output),
460	            })
461	        }
462	        AcceptanceCheck::FileExists { path, must_pass } => {
463	            let path = render_template(working_dir, &path);
464	            let exists = path.exists();
465	            Ok(AcceptanceCheckResult {
466	                kind: "file_exists".to_string(),
467	                passed: exists,
468	                must_pass,
469	                detail: if exists {
470	                    format!("{} exists", path.display())
471	                } else {
472	                    format!("{} is missing", path.display())
473	                },
474	                command: None,
475	                cwd: None,
476	                duration_ms: None,
477	                stdout: None,
478	                stderr: None,
479	            })
480	        }
481	        AcceptanceCheck::ContentMatch {
482	            path,
483	            pattern,
484	            must_pass,
485	        } => {
486	            let path = render_template(working_dir, &path);
487	            let body = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_default();
488	            let matched = regex::Regex::new(&pattern)
489	                .map(|regex| regex.is_match(&body))
490	                .unwrap_or_else(|_| body.contains(&pattern));
491	            Ok(AcceptanceCheckResult {
492	                kind: "content_match".to_string(),
493	                passed: matched,
494	                must_pass,
495	                detail: if matched {
496	                    format!("{} matches {:?}", path.display(), pattern)
497	                } else {
498	                    format!("{} does not match {:?}", path.display(), pattern)
499	                },
500	                command: None,
501	                cwd: None,
502	                duration_ms: None,
503	                stdout: None,
504	                stderr: None,
505	            })
506	        }
507	        AcceptanceCheck::BuildSuccess { cwd, must_pass } => {
508	            let cwd = render_template(working_dir, &cwd);
509	            let started = Instant::now();
510	            let output = Command::new("cargo")
511	                .arg("build")
512	                .current_dir(&cwd)
513	                .output()
514	                .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
515	                    path: cwd.join("Cargo.toml"),
516	                    source,
517	                })?;
518	            Ok(AcceptanceCheckResult {
519	                kind: "build_success".to_string(),
520	                passed: output.status.success(),
521	                must_pass,
522	                detail: format!(
523	                    "cargo build in {} exited with {}",
524	                    cwd.display(),
525	                    output.status
526	                ),
527	                command: Some("cargo build".to_string()),
528	                cwd: Some(cwd),
529	                duration_ms: Some(duration_ms(started)),
530	                stdout: clipped_stdout(&output),
531	                stderr: clipped_stderr(&output),
532	            })
533	        }
534	        AcceptanceCheck::Shell {
535	            command,
536	            cwd,
537	            must_pass,
538	        } => {
539	            let cwd = cwd
540	                .map(|cwd| render_template(working_dir, &cwd))
541	                .unwrap_or_else(|| working_dir.to_path_buf());
542	            let started = Instant::now();
543	            let output = Command::new("sh")
544	                .arg("-lc")
545	                .arg(&command)
546	                .current_dir(&cwd)
547	                .output()
548	                .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
549	                    path: cwd.clone(),
550	                    source,
551	                })?;
552	            Ok(AcceptanceCheckResult {
553	                kind: "shell".to_string(),
554	                passed: output.status.success(),
555	                must_pass,
556	                detail: format!(
557	                    "shell {:?} in {} exited with {}",
558	                    command,
559	                    cwd.display(),
560	                    output.status
561	                ),
562	                command: Some(command),
563	                cwd: Some(cwd),
564	                duration_ms: Some(duration_ms(started)),
565	                stdout: clipped_stdout(&output),
566	                stderr: clipped_stderr(&output),
567	            })
568	        }
569	    }
570	}

572	fn duration_ms(started: Instant) -> u64 {
573	    started.elapsed().as_millis().min(u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64
574	}
575	
576	fn clipped_stdout(output: &Output) -> Option<String> {
577	    clipped_output(&output.stdout)
578	}
579	
580	fn clipped_stderr(output: &Output) -> Option<String> {
581	    clipped_output(&output.stderr)
582	}
583	
584	fn clipped_output(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<String> {
585	    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).trim().to_string();
586	    if text.is_empty() {
587	        None
588	    } else {
589	        Some(clip_text(&text, 4096))
590	    }
591	}
592	
593	fn clip_text(text: &str, limit: usize) -> String {
594	    if text.len() <= limit {
595	        return text.to_string();
596	    }
597	    let mut clipped = text
598	        .char_indices()
599	        .take_while(|(idx, _)| *idx < limit)
600	        .map(|(_, ch)| ch)
601	        .collect::<String>();
602	    clipped.push_str("\n... output truncated ...");
603	    clipped
604	}
605	
606	fn format_command(base: &str, args: &[String]) -> String {
607	    if args.is_empty() {
608	        base.to_string()
609	    } else {
610	        format!("{base} {}", args.join(" "))
611	    }
612	}

614	fn parse_acceptance_checks(raw: &str) -> Result<Vec<AcceptanceCheck>> {
615	    let root: YamlValue = serde_yaml::from_str(raw).map_err(|source| {
616	        DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!("invalid acceptance.yaml: {source}"))
617	    })?;
618	    let mut checks = Vec::new();
619	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "checks")) {
620	        checks.push(parse_check_value(item, None)?);
621	    }
622	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "required")) {
623	        checks.push(parse_check_value(item, Some(true))?);
624	    }
625	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "optional")) {
626	        checks.push(parse_check_value(item, Some(false))?);
627	    }
628	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "tests")) {
629	        checks.push(parse_shell_check(item, true)?);
630	    }
631	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "file-exists")) {
632	        checks.push(parse_file_exists_check(item, true)?);
633	    }
634	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "content-match")) {
635	        checks.push(parse_content_match_check(item, true)?);
636	    }
637	    for item in yaml_seq(yaml_get(&root, "build-success")) {
638	        checks.push(parse_build_success_check(item, true));
639	    }
640	    Ok(checks)
641	}
642	
643	fn parse_check_value(value: &YamlValue, force_must_pass: Option<bool>) -> Result<AcceptanceCheck> {
644	    if let Ok(mut check) = serde_yaml::from_value::<AcceptanceCheck>(value.clone()) {
645	        if let Some(must_pass) = force_must_pass {
646	            check.set_must_pass(must_pass);
647	        }
648	        return Ok(check);
649	    }
650	    if let Some(command) = yaml_string(value) {
651	        return Ok(AcceptanceCheck::Shell {
652	            command,
653	            cwd: None,
654	            must_pass: force_must_pass.unwrap_or(true),
655	        });
656	    }
657	    let Some((kind, body)) = single_key_mapping(value) else {
658	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
659	            "invalid acceptance check: {:?}",
660	            value
661	        )));
662	    };
663	    let must_pass = force_must_pass.unwrap_or(true);
664	    match kind.as_str() {
665	        "file-exists" | "file_exists" => parse_file_exists_check(body, must_pass),
666	        "content-match" | "content_match" => parse_content_match_check(body, must_pass),
667	        "build-success" | "build_success" => Ok(parse_build_success_check(body, must_pass)),
668	        "shell" | "test" => parse_shell_check(body, must_pass),
669	        "cargo-test" | "cargo_test" => Ok(AcceptanceCheck::CargoTest {
670	            args: yaml_string(body).map(|arg| vec![arg]).unwrap_or_default(),
671	            must_pass,
672	        }),
673	        other => Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
674	            "unknown acceptance check kind {other}"
675	        ))),
676	    }
677	}
678	
679	fn parse_file_exists_check(value: &YamlValue, must_pass: bool) -> Result<AcceptanceCheck> {
680	    let path = yaml_string(value)
681	        .or_else(|| yaml_get(value, "path").and_then(yaml_string))
682	        .ok_or_else(|| DeadreckonError::InvalidInput("file-exists requires path".to_string()))?;
683	    Ok(AcceptanceCheck::FileExists { path, must_pass })
684	}
685	
686	fn parse_content_match_check(value: &YamlValue, must_pass: bool) -> Result<AcceptanceCheck> {
687	    let path = yaml_get(value, "path")
688	        .and_then(yaml_string)
689	        .ok_or_else(|| DeadreckonError::InvalidInput("content-match requires path".to_string()))?;
690	    let pattern = yaml_get(value, "pattern")
691	        .and_then(yaml_string)
692	        .ok_or_else(|| {
693	            DeadreckonError::InvalidInput("content-match requires pattern".to_string())
694	        })?;
695	    Ok(AcceptanceCheck::ContentMatch {
696	        path,
697	        pattern,
698	        must_pass,
699	    })
700	}
701	
702	fn parse_build_success_check(value: &YamlValue, must_pass: bool) -> AcceptanceCheck {
703	    let cwd = yaml_string(value)
704	        .or_else(|| yaml_get(value, "cwd").and_then(yaml_string))
705	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "{working_dir}".to_string());
706	    AcceptanceCheck::BuildSuccess { cwd, must_pass }
707	}
708	
709	fn parse_shell_check(value: &YamlValue, must_pass: bool) -> Result<AcceptanceCheck> {
710	    let command = yaml_string(value)
711	        .or_else(|| yaml_get(value, "command").and_then(yaml_string))
712	        .ok_or_else(|| DeadreckonError::InvalidInput("shell check requires command".to_string()))?;
713	    let cwd = yaml_get(value, "cwd").and_then(yaml_string);
714	    Ok(AcceptanceCheck::Shell {
715	        command,
716	        cwd,
717	        must_pass,
718	    })
719	}
720	
721	fn yaml_get<'a>(value: &'a YamlValue, key: &str) -> Option<&'a YamlValue> {
722	    value.as_mapping()?.get(YamlValue::String(key.to_string()))
723	}
724	
725	fn yaml_seq(value: Option<&YamlValue>) -> Vec<&YamlValue> {
726	    match value {
727	        Some(YamlValue::Sequence(values)) => values.iter().collect(),
728	        Some(value) => vec![value],
729	        None => Vec::new(),
730	    }
731	}
732	
733	fn yaml_string(value: &YamlValue) -> Option<String> {
734	    value.as_str().map(ToString::to_string)
735	}
736	
737	fn single_key_mapping(value: &YamlValue) -> Option<(String, &YamlValue)> {
738	    let mapping = value.as_mapping()?;
739	    if mapping.len() != 1 {
740	        return None;
741	    }
742	    let (key, value) = mapping.iter().next()?;
743	    Some((key.as_str()?.to_string(), value))
744	}
745	
746	impl AcceptanceCheck {
747	    fn set_must_pass(&mut self, value: bool) {
748	        match self {
749	            AcceptanceCheck::CargoTest { must_pass, .. }
750	            | AcceptanceCheck::FileExists { must_pass, .. }
751	            | AcceptanceCheck::ContentMatch { must_pass, .. }
752	            | AcceptanceCheck::BuildSuccess { must_pass, .. }
753	            | AcceptanceCheck::Shell { must_pass, .. } => *must_pass = value,
754	        }
755	    }
756	}
757	
758	fn render_template(working_dir: &Path, value: &str) -> PathBuf {
759	    PathBuf::from(value.replace("{working_dir}", &working_dir.to_string_lossy()))
760	}
761	
762	fn marker_signature(run_root: &Path, marker: &AcceptanceMarker) -> Result<String> {
763	    let nonce_path = gate_nonce_path_for_run_root(run_root);
764	    let nonce = std::fs::read_to_string(&nonce_path).with_path(&nonce_path)?;
765	    let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();
766	    nonce.trim().hash(&mut hasher);
767	    marker.schema_version.hash(&mut hasher);
768	    marker.run_id.hash(&mut hasher);
769	    marker.status.hash(&mut hasher);
770	    marker.produced_by.hash(&mut hasher);
771	    marker.checked_at.to_rfc3339().hash(&mut hasher);
772	    marker.working_dir.hash(&mut hasher);
773	    marker.check_count.hash(&mut hasher);
774	    for check in &marker.checks {
775	        check.hash(&mut hasher);
776	    }
777	    let tamper_path = crate::tamper::acceptance_tamper_path_for_run_root(run_root);
778	    match std::fs::read(&tamper_path) {
779	        Ok(bytes) => bytes.hash(&mut hasher),
780	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => "".hash(&mut hasher),
781	        Err(source) => {
782	            return Err(DeadreckonError::Io {
783	                path: tamper_path,
784	                source,
785	            });
786	        }
787	    }
788	    // A campaign result run carries its gate-verdict roll-up; binding it here means
789	    // the roll-up cannot be edited after signing to launder a refused leaf into a
790	    // clean pass. Absent (the normal, non-campaign case) hashes empty.
791	    let rollup_path = crate::campaign::rollup_path_at_run_root(run_root);
792	    match std::fs::read(&rollup_path) {
793	        Ok(bytes) => bytes.hash(&mut hasher),
794	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => "".hash(&mut hasher),
795	        Err(source) => {
796	            return Err(DeadreckonError::Io {
797	                path: rollup_path,
798	                source,
799	            });
800	        }
801	    }
802	    Ok(format!("{:016x}", hasher.finish()))
803	}
804	
805	fn default_must_pass() -> bool {
806	    true
807	}

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-05-28 23:57:20Z)**_

I've reviewed both changed files in full and traced the change against the threat model.

**What the change does:**

1. **`gate.rs`**: extends `marker_signature()` to hash the bytes of `run_root/campaign-rollup.json` into the marker signature (or empty string if absent). This is patterned exactly after the existing `tamper_path` binding immediately above — same `NotFound → ""` fallback, same fail-closed error propagation for other IO errors.

2. **`campaign.rs`**: adds pure helper `campaign_can_complete(campaign, rollup)` returning `all subs merged AND rollup not refused`. No sinks, no I/O, no inputs from untrusted sources.

**Security analysis:**

- **Tamper detection (intent of change):** The test `edited_rollup_file_fails_result_marker_signature` confirms: edit rollup after signing → validation fails. ✓
- **Post-signing add/delete of rollup:** If sign-time saw empty and validate-time sees content (or vice versa), bytes differ from `""` → signature mismatch → fail-closed. ✓
- **Forgery without nonce:** Signature is keyed with `gate_nonce` (per-run secret) at hasher start; attacker cannot recompute. ✓
- **Cross-run replay:** `run_id` is part of the signature input; markers don't transfer. ✓
- **Sibling-path gate parity:** `marker_signature` is the only signing path (called by both `write_acceptance_marker_with_results` and `validate_acceptance_marker`), so the binding is uniformly applied — no parallel marker writer that omits the new bind step. ✓
- **Fail-open on I/O errors:** The non-NotFound error branch returns `Err`, propagating to caller. Both sign and validate paths fail closed. ✓
- **Symlink at the rollup path:** Even if an attacker plants a symlink, signing and validation read through the same path symmetrically, and they still can't forge the signature without the nonce. ✓
- **Path traversal:** Path is computed from `run_root.join("campaign-rollup.json")` — no externally controlled component. ✓
- **`campaign_can_complete`:** Pure boolean conjunction over already-validated structs. No sink. The function correctly requires BOTH conditions (status==Merged AND rollup non-refused) — neither dominates the other. ✓
- **Non-campaign runs:** Always hash empty; symmetric on sign and validate, so non-campaign marker validation is unaffected. ✓

The binding is a straightforward extension of the existing tamper-binding pattern with identical fail-closed semantics. The change actually closes a previously-laundering pathway (post-signing edit of the rollup) and introduces no new one.

No security vulnerabilities found in this change.

**Summary:** The diff hardens campaign-result tamper-evidence by binding the campaign roll-up file bytes into the gate's marker signature, mirroring the existing tamper-file binding pattern verbatim (same `NotFound → ""` fallback, same fail-closed IO-error propagation). The companion `campaign_can_complete()` is a pure predicate combining `all subs Merged AND rollup not Refused` — no sinks or untrusted inputs.

Key checks:
- `marker_signature` is the sole signing path → uniform binding, no sibling-path bypass.
- Per-run secret `gate_nonce` keys the hash → no forgery without nonce.
- Empty-on-absent is symmetric between sign and validate → can't cause false matches across rollup state changes (add, delete, or edit all detected).
- Non-campaign runs unaffected (empty/empty on both sides).
- Test `edited_rollup_file_fails_result_marker_signature` confirms post-signing rollup edits invalidate the marker.
